zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空737MAX10僅前兩艙設座椅背螢幕、其餘座位採自備裝置
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空公布737MAX10機艙娛樂設計，僅最前方兩種艙等設座椅背螢幕，約占約159席中的15%，其餘旅客須自備裝置，首批高級布局預計2028年投入跨洲航線。
body: 阿拉斯加航空於9月29日在西雅圖投資人日公布737MAX10機艙布局，共設四種艙等，前方為平躺式套房艙與全新真正高級經濟艙，後方則為加腿部空間經濟艙與標準經濟艙。僅前兩種艙等會在松下Astrova系統上設置座椅背螢幕，約占約159席中的15%，加腿部空間經濟艙與標準經濟艙旅客須使用自備裝置。阿拉斯加航空表示，105架737MAX10中至少25架將採用此種布局。

阿拉斯加航空歷來反對在單走道機隊設置座椅背娛樂系統，以減輕機體重量，該公司表示主艙不設螢幕有助避免進一步複雜硬體認證延誤，並寄望免費Starlink無線網路足以滿足旅客需求。首架737MAX10預計2027年第二季交付，但平躺座椅要到2028年才會安裝，2027年率先交付的標準高密度布局為188席且全艙採自備裝置，與2028年的高級子機隊有所不同。該公司同時承諾，未來787機隊將在全部四種艙等設置座椅背螢幕。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to fit seatback screens only in the first two cabins of its transcontinental Boeing 737 MAX 10s
en.summary: Alaska Airlines has unveiled a 737 MAX 10 cabin design in which only the two most expensive cabins get seatback screens, covering roughly 15% of about 159 seats, while other passengers use their own devices.
body: Alaska Airlines announced the layout on September 29 at its Investor Day in Seattle. The MAX 10 will have four cabins: lie-flat Aurora Suites at the front, followed by Premium Reserve, its first true premium economy class, then Premium Class, which is extra-legroom economy, and finally Main Cabin standard economy seating. Only the first two cabins will get seatback screens, on Panasonic's Astrova system, while Premium Class and Main Cabin passengers will use their own devices. Alaska said at least 25 of its 105 MAX 10s will be configured in this arrangement.

Alaska has historically opposed seatback inflight entertainment on its single-aisle fleet to reduce aircraft weight, and it said keeping screens out of the main cabin helps avoid further complex hardware certification delays so the aircraft can enter service faster, with free Starlink WiFi expected to satisfy customers. The airline expects its first MAX 10 delivery in the second quarter of 2027, but the lie-flat seats will not be installed until 2028; the initial 2027 batch will use a standard high-density domestic layout with 188 seats and bring-your-own-device service across all rows, distinct from the premium-heavy 2028 subfleet. By contrast, Alaska has committed to seatback screens with Bluetooth across all four cabins on its future Boeing 787 Dreamliners.

facts.claim: Alaska Airlines announced its MAX 10 layout on September 29 at its Investor Day in Seattle, with four cabins and seatback screens only in the first two cabins.
Only the two most expensive cabins get screens, roughly 15% of about 159 seats, while other passengers are on a bring-your-own-device plan.
At least 25 of the 105 MAX 10s will be configured with this arrangement.

Alaska expects its first MAX 10 delivery in the second quarter of 2027, but the lie-flat seats will not be installed until 2028, and the initial 2027 batch uses a standard 188-seat layout with bring-your-own-device service across all rows.
Alaska said keeping screens out of the main cabin helps avoid further complex hardware certification delays and that it is counting on free Starlink WiFi to satisfy customers.
